topic: The phone call received from a number disconnected 20 years earlier
hook: She got a call from a number disconnected 20 years ago.
script: She got a call from a number disconnected 20 years ago. Multiple documented cases exist of people receiving phone calls from numbers belonging to deceased relatives — numbers that telecom records confirm were disconnected years prior. In one case, the voice on the call described details of the caller's life that only the deceased could have known. Phone companies have investigated. No technical explanation has ever been given. Follow for real cases that make you afraid to answer the phone.
